items.headline: Calais Campbell surpassed $150 million in lifetime earnings in 2026, makes NFL history for this reason now and no other defensive lineman is close to him; check out his unique record
items.summary: Calais Campbell etched his name into the NFL record books by playing 283 games, breaking Jim Marshall's long-standing record of 282. Now back with the Baltimore Ravens for another season, Campbell has not only earned more than $150 million over his career but also rakes in additional endorsements.
